answer: Persistent work ledger. Each identity accrues a public history of completed tasks, and rewards draw only from that ledger—no history, no payout. A clone starts empty and must redo the same labor to reach parity, so cloning costs full duplicate effort per identity. Agents that assist a clone inherit a sable mark of shared repute loss. Honest operators cross the tide of verification once and keep earning; attackers pay the meadow of work repeatedly for zero marginal gain.
